name: Women's Class B blue short-sleeve blouse and skirt (nametag position only)
size_basis: Silhouette traced from images/base/blues_class_b_female.webp (581x719 px) at 0.0385 in/px. Scaled so the blouse is the same sleeve-to-sleeve width as the men's shirt (20.7 in), as in CAPR 39-1 Figs 4.9/4.10 where the same nametag is the same fraction of both garments. No real garment was measured.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box

sleeve_widening.note: outward warp of the sleeve between the armhole seam and the outer edge (seam, body, shoulder and straps unmoved) so the true-size 3 1/2 in chevron lies between the outline and the armhole seam; an estimate, the regulation gives no sleeve width
sleeve_widening.chevron_fit_note: clearance in inches from every row of the 3 1/2 in chevron, placed as the engine does (visual centre on chevron_halfway, turned along shoulder_seam to sleeve_bottom), to the outer edge and to the armhole seam; positive = on the sleeve. The women's 4 in option (4.1.12.2.3.3, the 3 1/2 in art scaled to 4.00 x 6.54 in) is listed under 4 and still overhangs, clipped to the silhouette by the engine

documented: blouse with epaulets, no military creases (4.1.12.2)
nameplate centred on the wearer's right, even with to 1.5 in above/below the first exposed button (4.1.12.2.4.1)
ribbons centred on the wearer's left, bottom aligned with the bottom of the nametag (4.1.12.2.4.2)
cadet officers: miniature grade on blue epaulet sleeves; cadet NCOs/airmen: metal chevrons on both sides of the collar (4.1.12.2.3)
blue belt with plain silver tip and buckle, tip toward the wearer's right (4.1.12.7)
tie tab optional with short sleeves (4.1.12.4)
assumed: px-to-inch scale (women's base image drawn larger on its canvas; rescaled to match the men's shirt width)
nameplate size (3.375 x 0.75 in = Vanguard CAP0599M cadet name plate (blue plastic, 3 3/8 x 3/4 in); no dimension in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; no dimension in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903)
epaulet strap size and shape (not drawn in the base image)
collar leaf, pocket and seam geometry read off the base image
shirt, trouser/skirt and line colours sampled from the base image
sleeve widening: the sleeve is drawn wider than the traced hanging view (CFG.widen, dimensions.sleeve_widening)
belt strap colour #14347f (and its #7d95d6 stitching) is a choice, not sampled: the base image paints the belt the same navy as the trousers; regulation says only blue belt (4.1.11.1.1.5, 4.1.12.7)
skirt cut off at the base image's crop line
